reply.text: {"route": "answer", "say": "Sore but motivated is a good place to start from. Soreness on its own doesn't mean you should skip, so if the planned session is in front of you, I'd do it at a lower intensity: keep your warm-up longer, cut your working weights back a notch, and stop short of grinding out reps. If the soreness is sharp, gets worse as you move, or is in a joint, rest that session and tell me where it is so we can adjust the plan around it."}
